<thought>The spectrum shows a dominant M peak at 233.96 and a secondary peak exactly 2 Da higher (235.96) with an intensity about 24 % of the base peak. This 2 Da spacing with a ~1:3 intensity ratio is the characteristic isotopic pattern of chlorine (35Cl/37Cl ≈ 75 %/25 %). No other element has such a distinctive M/M+2 pattern at this intensity, so chlorine can be definitively identified. Other elements (C, H, N, O, S) do not produce a uniquely recognizable pattern here. Therefore the only element that can be definitively identified from the isotope distribution is chlorine.</thought>
<final_answer>['Cl']</final_answer>
